verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'We have liftoff' (2026-04-01); R5: 'launched on 1 April'
verifications.reasoning: Both sources directly confirm the launch date as April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight test of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Artemis II test flight will be NASA’s first mission with crew aboard the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft'; R2: first crewed mission beyond low Earth orbit since 1972 around the moon
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states it is the first crewed SLS/Orion mission; R2 supports contextually.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission lifted off at 18:35 CDT on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R5 directly states the exact time in CDT; other sources give compatible window but not contradicting.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission lifted off at 23:35 BST on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R5 directly states the exact time in BST.

verifications.claim: The objective of the Artemis II mission is testing SLS/Orion with crew Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: R1 exactly matches crew names and test objective for SLS/Orion.
